At the top of every stock\'s detail are its \"Targets\" for three horizons. Intraday (today only, MIS): from today\'s 5-minute candles; a close above the 9:15–9:30 range and above VWAP is a BUY, a close below it and below VWAP a SELL; the stop sits at the range\'s middle, targets at 1:1.5 and 1:2; no new entry after 14:45, square off by 15:15. Short-term (2 days to 4 weeks, delivery): the trade plan\'s entry, stop and first two targets, with how many days they take. Long-term (1 to 5 years): the R/S framework\'s buy price and fair value, and the price at the company\'s own usual P/E. Menu → \"Today\'s intraday\" has the app pick, from the scan\'s most traded stocks, which to BUY and which to SELL today, strongest first; tap one for its detail. These are estimates from prices alone, not investment advice.
